decision: Preserve the exact-record R2 control-plane boundary, but replace its impossible cross-API ctime equality wording with a portable identity contract. H1R-04 remains product-pending and no candidate classification is authorized.

supersedes.scope: Only filesystem identity comparison semantics and their tests are corrected. The R2 exact record path, schema, manifest v2, effective digest, sibling visibility, no-live boundary and all inherited R1 contracts remain authoritative.

observed_platform_vector.conclusion: For an unchanged file, Windows lstat and handle fstat expose different st_ctime_ns meanings. Requiring those two raw values to equal rejects every valid read and is not a security property.

comparison_sequence: Capture initial component lstat path snapshots including complete st_mode and st_ctime_ns.
Open exactly once and require the first descriptor fstat to equal the final-path lstat on every cross_view_fields_exact field, including complete permission bits.
On non-Windows platforms additionally require first descriptor st_ctime_ns to equal final-path lstat st_ctime_ns.
After reading, require the second descriptor fstat to equal the first descriptor fstat on every descriptor_snapshot_fields_exact field.
After close, recapture every component lstat and require equality with the initial lstat on every path_snapshot_fields_exact field.
portable_identity_contract.permission_rule: Any stable executable permission bit on the exact JSON record fails control_plane_record_invalid. Any mode change between path and descriptor, during descriptor reading, or between initial and final path snapshots fails toctou_changed on every platform.
portable_identity_contract.ctime_rule: A descriptor ctime change after the first descriptor snapshot or a path-component ctime change visible between initial and final path snapshots fails toctou_changed on every platform. POSIX also enforces lstat-to-first-fstat ctime equality. Windows deliberately does not compare raw ctime across those APIs and does not claim to detect a ctime-only metadata transition between initial lstat and first fstat when that transition is thereafter stable and not reflected by any cross-view field or final path snapshot.
portable_identity_contract.failure_rule: No platform may normalize, overwrite or discard st_mode. No platform may discard ctime from both channel-local comparisons. Unknown platform behavior fails closed through the ordinary identity mismatch checks.
portable_identity_contract.windows_threat_boundary: The verifier detects content, size, mtime, device/inode, file-attribute and complete-mode changes across path and descriptor views, including chmod. It does not claim to sandbox a malicious privileged Windows actor or to detect an ACL/security-descriptor-only transition that occurs before the first handle snapshot and is invisible to all declared stat fields. Run against a quiescent trusted checkout, consistent with the inherited R1 TOCTOU threat boundary.

effective_contract_patch.scan_contract_digest_rule: The effective census contract digest covers inherited R1, the entire R2 boundary_contract, and the entire portable_identity_contract under portable_identity_boundary. The R3 diagnostic platform vector is not hashed.
effective_contract_patch.architecture_binding_rule: The scanner must safe-read and raw-blob-bind R1, R2 and this R3 artifact before constructing the effective in-memory contract. Any absence, drift or inconsistent supersedes pin fails identity_mismatch.

required_delta: Represent cross-view and channel snapshot identities separately rather than truncating an opaque tuple.
Use complete st_mode in both representations.
Compare ctime channel-locally on Windows and both channel-locally plus cross-view on POSIX.
Bind R3 and include portable_identity_boundary in the effective scan digest.
Regenerate the schema-2 discovery manifest without changing any classification.
implementation_scope.forbidden: No product-roadmap/status edit, state classification, migration, data/private read, provider/network action, deployment, deletion, push, Codex configuration change or other live effect.

hostile_tests: The real unchanged Windows lstat/fstat ctime divergence vector is accepted when all cross-view fields and both channel-local snapshots are stable.
On POSIX, a first-fstat ctime-only mismatch against initial lstat fails toctou_changed.
On Windows, the real benign lstat/fstat ctime divergence is accepted; no test or implementation may infer a race from that difference alone.
A second-fstat ctime-only drift fails toctou_changed.
A final-lstat ctime-only drift on the file or any parent component fails toctou_changed.
A permission-bit change in any cross-view or channel-local transition fails toctou_changed; a stable executable exact record fails control_plane_record_invalid.
All R2 exact-path, schema, paused-state, sibling and manifest/digest hostile gates remain green.
real_repository: Focused and dependency suites plus Round6, Integration Spine and Guidance validators pass.
After release changes the exact excluded run record, the unchanged manifest passes again with identical files, candidates, counts and member digest.
Default validation remains exit 2 with only unclassified_candidates.
acceptance_gates.independent_review: Two independent reviewers must PASS the exact R3 bytes and the final three implementation blobs. A failure freezes the candidate and authorizes only a fresh correction.
